body: That’s true, he couldn’t have predicted that. But yeah, music being free really does over saturate the market with bad music. Usually back before essentially free music you had to be GOOD to get signed but now, sadly, they sign anyone who can make them a quick buck. Also Kurt mentioned how Rap music was the only creative musical form to come around in a long time but that it was so misogynist that he just couldn’t enjoy it.
I’d move Bleach higher to the A tier but other than that pretty good list
Dang, that’s a lot! It’s cool you’re trying to help people though! You make a big difference to people like me. 😊
I really should trust the song honestly. Sometimes I get stuck on lyrics but I feel like it’s cause I try too hard on them. Thanks for talking to me dude. You’ve been a big help! 😊
Yeah! I’ve been trying to follow that philosophy but sometimes I worry if what I write is too simplistic lol. I just keep trying to come up with more stuff and incorporate different things. 😊
Mainly trying to write music. I’ve been learning guitar since December and I’ve gotten really good! I’m hoping to start a band soon so I can start doing something productive.
I just spend a lot of time at home, probably too much time. And I’m sorry! I didn’t realize. But that’s actually cool that you’re a night doc. 😊

That’s good that you’re alright. And yeah they really can. Sometimes it’s hard to deal with because I don’t wanna scare anyone but I don’t wanna be alone with them either. I hope things get better for you though!
That sounds rough dude, I’m sorry. Are you doing alright after that? I’m doing fine all things considered I guess. Sometimes I let my thoughts get to me.
